method: OpenAI ImageGen supplied tightly constrained, composition-locked pose anchors for the clean hand/spoon motion. The accepted pose anchors are used whole to preserve their internally coherent anatomy. The depleted-gelato output is the exception: only a feathered cavity patch is used, after motion synthesis, so it cannot alter the approved hand, spoon, glasses, face, or timing.

selected.promptSummary: Exact midpoint between loaded mid-chest and raised-spoon poses; preserve identity, camera, glasses, cup and background; exactly one coherent hand and one straight spoon.
Subtle bite contact with spoon bowl just inside the lips, hand left of and separate from the sunglasses; exactly one arm, hand and spoon.
Early withdrawal with an empty spoon just below the lower lip, coherent grip and a clean gap from the sunglasses.
Later empty-spoon withdrawal toward the upper chest; preserve all non-moving elements and single connected anatomy.
Close approach midpoint between the near-mouth and bite-contact poses; preserve a single coherent chocolate-loaded spoon and a clean gap from the sunglasses.
Immediate post-bite pose with the empty spoon only a few centimetres from the lower lip and well above the hanging sunglasses.
Mid-withdrawal pose between the high and chest-level empty-spoon keys, with one coherent hand and no sunglasses overlap.
Exact clean midpoint between the high and mid-withdrawal keys, replacing the only remaining ghosted RIFE frame.
Close-up local edit removing one spoonful from the chocolate mound as a clearly scraped cavity; preserve the loaded spoon, other flavours, cup and scene. Only the cavity patch is used.
